ref: #2 §3 and §4 collapseContexts, STD: "Empty contexts (= ResultList.SUPPRESS) are replaced by empty strings" [SAP✓ https://help.sap.com/saphelp_nwpi711/helpdata/en/43/c4cdfc334824478090739c04c4a249/content.htm]; ADR-0006 Consequences since #51: a SUPPRESS first slot is "" (documented)
note: Tag in its default context Order is false, true | true | (none), so createIf gives SUPPRESS, "" | "" | (empty). Each context's first slot, SUPPRESS and the empty context alike, is "": three empty All. A SUPPRESS kept as the first value gives two.
